examShortTricks: Trick 1: Colligative = depends on the NUMBER of solute particles, not their nature — say the definition first; then the four: Δp/p° = x2, ΔTb = Kb·m, ΔTf = Kf·m, π = CRT.
Trick 2: ΔTb = Kb·m and ΔTf = Kf·m — molality in both; Kf for water 1.86, Kb 0.52 K kg/mol; every numerical is one multiplication.
Trick 3: Molar mass from freezing point: M2 = (Kf·w2·1000)/(ΔTf·w1) — the most-asked numerical template.
Trick 4: Osmotic pressure π = nRT/V — preferred for polymers because it is measurable at room temperature with tiny concentrations.
